data.name: Mahdi
data.gender_notes: Mahdi is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ه-د-ي (h-d-y), 'to guide'. Mahdī means 'rightly guided'. Its root is ه-د-ي (h-d-y). An eschatological figure in Islamic tradition. Mahdi is a Arabic name meaning “Guided; rightly guided one”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mahdi expresses “Guided; rightly guided one”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ه-د-ي (h-d-y), 'to guide'. Mahdī means 'rightly guided'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahdi total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
